title: Pricing Policy for the Variable Contract Rate on Operating Lines of Credit
content:
Every one of the Operating Lines of Credit carries a variable contract rate equal to the Association Variable Base Rate in effect on the rate effective date plus the product's spread, minus the discounts the line qualifies for on that date.

## Association Variable Base Rate history

The base rate in effect on a rate effective date is the rate of the latest history entry whose effective date is on or before that date.

| Effective date | Association Variable Base Rate (% a year) |
|---|---|
| 2025-09-18 | 7.750 |
| 2025-10-30 | 7.500 |
| 2025-12-11 | 7.250 |
| 2026-04-30 | 7.000 |
| 2026-07-30 | 6.750 |

## Clauses in force

1. A discount the product does not offer is zero, not a reason to raise another.
2. The result is rounded to 3 decimal places and may not be lower than the product's rate floor.
3. The rate is set on the booking date and on every renewal effective date. It is recomputed with the same components when AutoDraft is enrolled or cancelled, effective the date of the change, and when the base rate changes, effective on the base-rate history date, for every line in active, suspended or matured status.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of this pricing policy are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current basis for that discount or for the combination of discounts:

- "The program discount is the product's program discount." — no longer in force.
- "The AutoDraft discount is the product's AutoDraft discount and applies only while AutoDraft is enrolled on the line." — no longer in force.
- "The relationship discount is the product's relationship discount and applies only while the member holds at least one Farm Real Estate loan in active status." — no longer in force.
- "Discounts are added together and the total is capped at the product's discount cap." — no longer in force.
- "Losing the relationship discount because a Farm Real Estate loan closed takes effect only at the next renewal, never mid-term." — no longer in force.

## Reading the base rate history (hypothetical rate effective dates)

| Rate effective date | Latest entry on or before it | Base rate used |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-12-10 | 2025-10-30 | 7.500 |
| 2025-12-11 | 2025-12-11 | 7.250 |
| 2026-05-15 | 2026-04-30 | 7.000 |
| 2026-07-30 | 2026-07-30 | 6.750 |

## Rounding and floor (hypothetical figures)

On a Borrowing Base Operating Line, a base rate of 6.750% plus the 0.10-point spread less a hypothetical discount total of 0.15 points gives 6.700%, above the 4.75% floor, so 6.700% stands. A computed figure below the product's floor is replaced by the floor itself.

superseded_clauses: The AutoDraft discount is autodraft_rate_discount_pct and applies only while autodraft_enrolled is true.
The relationship discount is relationship_rate_discount_pct and applies only while the member holds at least one Farm Real Estate loan in active status (operating_msr_active_farmland).
Losing the relationship discount because a Farm Real Estate loan closed takes effect only at the next renewal, never mid-term.
Discounts are added together and the total is capped at rate_discount_cap_pct
